title: Deng Ai's march by Yinping
summary: Following the Sanguozhi: with Zhong Hui stopped at Jiange, Deng Ai takes an unguarded track through seven hundred li of mountains, comes out behind the Shu defences and forces Chengdu to surrender.
sources: 《三國志·魏書·鄧艾傳》, Deng Ai's proposal and the march to Chengdu (sources/yinping-sanguozhi.md)

zh.title: 邓艾偷渡阴平
zh.summary: 据《三国志》：钟会受阻于剑阁，邓艾取道无人把守的阴平小道，穿越七百余里群山，绕到蜀军防线之后，迫使成都投降。
sources: 《三国志·魏书·邓艾传》，邓艾上言及进军成都两段（原文见 sources/yinping-sanguozhi.md）

places.name: Yinping
places.note: Where Deng Ai's march into the wilderness began (near modern Wen county).

zh.name: 阴平
zh.note: 邓艾向无人之地进军的起点（今文县一带）。

places.name: Motianling ridge
places.note: The high ridge on the Yinping track, where the easiest way from Yinping over the divide crosses it. Tradition places here the descent where Deng Ai 'wrapped himself in felt and rolled down'. Position approximate.

zh.name: 摩天岭
zh.note: 阴平道上的高岭，从阴平越过分水岭最省力的路线在此通过。相传邓艾“以毡自裹，推转而下”就在这里。位置为约略。

places.name: Jiangyou
places.note: The first Shu post Deng Ai reached; its commander Ma Miao surrendered.

zh.name: 江由（江油关）
zh.note: 邓艾先登所至的第一处蜀军据点，守将马邈投降。

places.name: Jiange (Jianmen Pass)
places.note: Jiang Wei holds the pass on the main road into Shu; Zhong Hui attacks it and cannot take it.

zh.name: 剑阁（剑门关）
zh.note: 姜维据守蜀道干线上的关隘，钟会进攻不克。

places.name: Fu
places.note: Deng Ai's target: 'a hundred li west of Jiange, three hundred li from Chengdu' (modern Mianyang).

zh.name: 涪
zh.note: 邓艾的目标：“出剑阁西百里，去成都三百余里”（今绵阳）。

places.name: Mianzhu
places.note: Zhuge Zhan falls back here from Fu and is defeated and killed.

zh.name: 绵竹
zh.note: 诸葛瞻自涪退还绵竹，兵败被斩。

places.name: Luo
places.note: Deng Ai's army reaches Luo; Liu Shan sends his seal and surrenders.

zh.name: 雒
zh.note: 邓艾进军到雒，刘禅奉玺绶请降。

places.name: Guangyuan
places.note: On the main road from Hanzhong into Shu, north of Jiange; shown for orientation.

zh.name: 广元
zh.note: 汉中入蜀干道上、剑阁以北的城市，标出以便定位。

routes.name: Zhong Hui on the main road

zh.name: 钟会循干道攻剑阁
zh.note: 魏军主力沿入蜀干道南下，受阻于剑阁。

routes.note: The main Wei army comes down the main road into Shu and is stopped at Jiange.

routes.name: The main road beyond Jiange

zh.name: 剑阁以南的干道
zh.note: 如果剑阁守军回救涪县，钟会就能“方轨而进”的道路。

routes.note: The way Zhong Hui could go 'two carts abreast' if Jiange's garrison left to defend Fu.

routes.name: Deng Ai by the Yinping track

zh.name: 邓艾自阴平道
zh.note: “行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道，造作桥阁”，粮运将匮。

routes.note: 'Seven hundred li through uninhabited land': cutting tracks through mountains, building bridges and galleries, with supplies running out.

routes.name: Zhuge Zhan falls back to Mianzhu

zones.name: Jiange: the gate of Shu
zones.note: A gap in a long line of cliffs across the main road.

zh.name: 剑阁：蜀之门户
zh.note: 横亘干道的一线悬崖上的缺口。

zones.name: Seven hundred li of uninhabited land

steps.title: Stopped at Jiange
steps.text:
Jiang Wei holds Jiange, and Zhong Hui attacks but cannot take it.

The viewshed from the pass shows what the defenders command: the approach along the main road lies open below them, while the cliffs on either side close every other way.

zh.title: 受阻剑阁
zh.text:
姜维据守剑阁，钟会攻之不克。

从关上看出去的可视域，显示守军控制的范围：干道上的来路尽在眼下，两侧悬崖封住了其他一切通道。

steps.title: Deng Ai's proposal
steps.text: Deng Ai argues that the enemy is shaken and should be pressed: go from Yinping by a side track, by way of the Han Deyang pavilion, to Fu, coming out a hundred li west of Jiange and three hundred li from Chengdu, a surprise blow at the heart. If Jiange's garrison turns back to save Fu, Zhong Hui can march in two carts abreast; if it does not, Fu will be weakly held. 'Attack where they are unprepared; go where they do not expect you.'

zh.title: 邓艾上言
zh.text: 邓艾上言：敌人已受挫，应当乘势进击，从阴平由小路经汉德阳亭直趋涪县，出剑阁西百里，离成都三百余里，以奇兵冲其腹心。剑阁守军如回救涪县，钟会便可方轨而进；如不回救，涪县的守兵就少了。兵书说：“攻其无备，出其不意。”

steps.title: Seven hundred li of wilderness
steps.text:
In the tenth month Deng Ai marches from Yinping through more than seven hundred li of uninhabited land, cutting tracks through the mountains and building bridges and galleries. The mountains are high and the valleys deep; supplies are running out, and the army is often in danger.

The profile shows the climbs and descents of the Yinping track.

analysis.label: The Yinping track, Yinping to Fu

zh.title: 无人之地七百余里
zh.text:
冬十月，邓艾自阴平道行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道，造作桥阁。山高谷深，极为艰险，粮运又将匮乏，屡次陷于危境。

剖面显示了阴平道上的起伏。

steps.title: Rolling down in felt
steps.text: At the hardest place Deng Ai wraps himself in felt and rolls down the slope; his officers and men climb down clinging to trees and cliff faces, one after another like a string of fish.

zh.title: 以毡自裹，推转而下
zh.text: 邓艾在最险处以毡自裹，推转而下；将士们攀木缘崖，鱼贯而进。

steps.title: The track against the main road
steps.text: Both ways end at Fu. The comparison sets the Yinping track beside the main road through Jiange: the length of each, and how much climbing it takes. The main road was the one everyone watched; the track was the one nobody guarded.

analysis.label: Yinping track vs the main road through Jiange

zh.label: 阴平道与经剑阁的干道比较

zh.title: 小道与干道
zh.text: 两条路都通到涪县。比较把阴平道与经剑阁的干道并列：各自的长度和爬升。干道是人人盯着的路，小道是无人把守的路。

steps.title: Jiangyou, Fu and Mianzhu
steps.text: Deng Ai's vanguard reaches Jiangyou, and the Shu commander Ma Miao surrenders. Zhuge Zhan falls back from Fu to Mianzhu and draws up to meet him. Deng Ai's son Zhong and Shi Zuan, attacking on the flanks, are driven back and report that the enemy cannot be beaten; Deng Ai threatens to behead them: 'Survival or ruin hangs on this one battle.' They attack again and destroy Zhuge Zhan's army.

zh.title: 江由、涪、绵竹
zh.text: 邓艾先登至江由，蜀守将马邈投降。诸葛瞻自涪退还绵竹，列阵以待。邓艾派儿子邓忠和司马师纂从左右进攻，失利退回，说“贼未可击”。邓艾大怒：“存亡之分，在此一举，何不可之有？”要斩二人。二人驰还再战，大破蜀军，斩诸葛瞻及尚书张遵。

steps.title: Chengdu surrenders
steps.text: Deng Ai advances to Luo. Liu Shan sends envoys with the imperial seal and a letter of surrender. Jiange, the pass that could not be taken, never had to be.

zh.title: 成都请降
zh.text: 邓艾进军到雒。刘禅遣使奉皇帝玺绶，作笺向邓艾请降。那座攻不下的剑阁，最终也不必再攻了。
